Runs counts the runs per setting on the TPU. Experiment 0 is the stand-alone baseline run of each session in Table~\ref{tab:platforms}, which also gives its script. Each session of September 15 to 17, 2026, also ran the baseline configuration once with the profiler. On the TPU, the baseline configuration is also one setting of experiments 2, 4, and 7. Both settings of experiments 3 and 6 use the baseline configuration. All three runs of experiment 8 use the baseline configuration. With experiment 0, the TPU runs of the baseline configuration are the 11 runs of Section~\ref{sec:experiments}. The scripts are in \texttt{src/}. \emph{Single} is \texttt{spike\_tpu\_forward\_pass.py}, \emph{vmap} is \texttt{spike\_batch\_forward\_pass.py}, \emph{pmap} is \texttt{spike\_pmap\_forward\_pass.py}, \emph{partitioning} is \texttt{spike\_meshshard\_forward\_pass.py}, and \emph{ensemble} is \texttt{spike\_ensemble\_shard\_forward\_pass.py}. \emph{Alphabet} and \emph{fixed} are the repeated-alphabet and fixed sequences, followed by the length in residues when the experiment does not vary it. File gives the start of the file name. Files are in \texttt{results/sweep/}. The files of experiment 0 are in \texttt{results/}. Unless an experiment varies one of these settings, all runs use \texttt{model\_3}, zero recycles, and float32 parameters.
